name: Assembly Health
desc:
Medical Billing Call Center Representative | $17 to $20/hr | Inbound Patient Billing Calls, No Sales Expectations
Company: Assembly Health
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Assembly Health handles billing for healthcare providers like doctor's offices, post-acute care communities, and behavioral health centers. In this role, you answer calls from patients about their medical bills and try to solve each issue on the first call. You'll update patient and insurance information, take credit card payments, and work through tasks in internal work queues. You'll also call back patients who reached out through the website, give updated information to collection agencies, answer attorney requests for balances, and bill insurance. For patients paying on their own, you'll review mail, post payments, and resolve concerns. It's a busy mix of phone work and account work.

Soft Skills
- Friendly, professional phone manner
- Staying calm under pressure
- Attention to detail
- Self-motivation
- Teamwork
assessment: Based on what former applicants describe, expect a recruiter screening call followed by a Zoom interview rather than a timed skills test, though that can vary by client team.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: None strictly required
Preferred Experience: High-volume call center or customer support experience. Healthcare experience is a big plus.

Required Skills:
- Excellent communication and a professional manner
- Works well under tight deadlines
- Strong written and verbal communication with a customer service focus
- Detail-oriented, self-motivated team player
- Handles a fast-paced, sometimes stressful environment
- Comfortable sitting at a computer for long periods and occasionally lifting up to 10 pounds

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has call center or customer service experience and wants to move into healthcare
- Is comfortable taking payments and handling private account details
- Likes solving problems on the first call
- Wants a growing company that promotes from within

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Doesn't want to talk with patients about money or unpaid balances
- Struggles in a fast-paced, sometimes stressful setting
- Doesn't like juggling phone calls and computer tasks
- Prefers a simple, phone-only job
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process. All real Assembly Health recruiting emails come from an @assembly.health address. Treat anything from another address as fake.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Medical billing
- Call center
- Patient account management
- Insurance billing
- Payment processing
- Collections
- One-call resolution
- Healthcare customer service
- Confidential data handling
- Self-pay account management

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your call center or customer service experience.
- A patient is upset about a bill they didn't expect. How would you handle the call?
- How do you stay organized when you're updating accounts and taking payments during a call?
- Tell us about a time you solved a customer's problem on the first call. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you worked under a tight deadline. What was the situation, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $17 to $20/hr, based on skills, experience, and location. Some employees may also qualify for company bonus programs.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, retirement plans including a 401(k), HSAs and FSAs, PTO, and paid holidays.
-Equipment Provided: Yes
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case, depending on the charge
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is a full-time, non-exempt role reporting to the Director of Call Center. Assembly is growing and offers ongoing training, and their careers page shares an example of a Patient Registration Coordinator promoted to Team Lead within a year. All real recruiting emails come from @assembly.health. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Medical Billing Call Center Representative → Call Center Team Lead → Call Center Supervisor → Call Center Operations Manager. This role builds medical billing, payment processing, and patient account skills.
